title: WatArrow RC Aircraft
what: A student design team RC aircraft featuring modular wings and programmable control surfaces.
why: To compete in the SAE Aero East 2025 micro class division and achieve reliable flight performance.
how: Prototyped foam-cut control surfaces and fabricated CNC-cut balsa wing ribs with heat-shrink laminate. Drafted electrical schematics and wired servos to the flight computer with banana-plug harnesses. Debugged a flap-creep issue during the competition, helping team to secure 3rd-place in mission points.
